dj_set.use: Pool party DJ set (replaces the synthesized party/track.ts). Deep house, A minor, instrumental. Planned as 16-bar drop, 8 breakdown, 8 build, twice; loops.

concert_1.title: Chasing Dawn
concert_1.use: The concert's song: Chasing Dawn, the owner's own track (artist lucidium2000, made with Suno), sung. Sections read from its measured energy.

casino_lounge.use: Casino floor music (replaces the 8-bar renderGroove loop in audio.ts). Lounge house / nu-jazz, A minor, 116 BPM, 64 bars, loops.

jackpot.use: Slot jackpot: bells and coins into a tray.

cheer.use: Pool crowd cheering as Orlo finishes a song.

applause.use: Crowd applause at the stage, with whistles.

floor_loop.use: Optional casino floor room tone, seamless 30 s loop (the procedural floor in ambience.ts may already be better: compare before using).

deck_a.title: No Tomorrow

deck_c.title: One More Drop
deck_c.use: The DJ's record after the headliner's set: One More Drop, the owner's own track (artist lucidium2000, made with Suno). Played once through on deck A, then the house record again.

deck_b.title: Woo and Oh Yeah
